cancrops:handbook-guide-text: Every crop carries a genome that you can improve through selective breeding. Seeds have inheritable stats, a species pair and resistance: cross plants together to combine traits and unlock new species. Genome stats Five inheritable stats (0..10): Gain (drop amount), Growth (faster stages), Strength (longer perish time, wider light range), Resistance (wider cold/heat tolerance window), Fertility (chance to be picked as a parent). Each stat has a dominant and a recessive allele; only the dominant value affects the plant, but the recessive one is passed on. Seed tooltip Hover a seed to see its stats, species pair (recessive in brackets), the effective light range (MinLight..MaxLight, widened by Strength), and cold/heat damage thresholds adjusted by Resistance. Cross-breeding Plant two mature crops next to each other on farmland. Place Selection Sticks between them. Over a few in-game days the sticks pick the most fertile neighbours, combine their genomes, and either spawn a clone or attempt a registered mutation on adjacent farmland. The sticks are consumed once the crop spawns. Mutation conditions Some crosses only happen under specific conditions: a light range at the sticks, a temperature and rainfall window, a particular block nearby, or a matching biome. A perfect spot can even force the mutation to trigger regardless of chance. Check the relevant content pack's handbook entry for which crops need what. Clipping Use shears on a mature crop to collect extra seeds without uprooting the plant. The clipped seed inherits the parent genome with small per-stat variance, useful for stabilising a sorted lineage. Weeds Crops may develop weeds that progress through stages and spread to neighbouring farmland. Higher Resistance reduces both appearance and spread. Use the Hand Cultivator to clear weeds, or the Anti-weed item for a temporary protection window. Shade-tolerant crops Plants accept a lightSensitivity value (0..1, default 1). Crops with 0 grow in full darkness without penalty: useful for indoor and cave farms (mushrooms in the additionals pack). Commands /cancrops setstat <name> <value> sets a stat (gain/growth/strength/resistance/fertility) on the seed in your active hotbar slot. Requires controlserver privilege.
